name: Bachelor of Finance
title: Bachelor of Finance (BFM — Financial Markets)
intro: Admission, six semesters of finance study, internships and the MBA, CFA or jobs path.

phases.title: Class 12 prerequisites
phases.summary: Commerce with Maths is ideal; other streams are accepted.
points: BFM admits students from Commerce and, depending on the college, other streams.
Maths, Economics and Accountancy in Class 12 help.
Check the minimum marks for the college you want.
Follow market news to build interest.

phases.title: Admission process
phases.summary: Merit list or entrance depending on the university.
points: Apply through the college or university admissions portal.
Select your college preferences and upload documents.
Follow merit lists and fee deadlines.
CUET-UG is used by some universities.

phases.title: Six semesters of finance study
phases.summary: Financial accounting, markets, investment and risk.
points: Year 1: Financial Accounting, Business Economics, Statistics and Business Communication.
Year 2: Corporate Finance, Financial Markets, Banking, Taxation and Cost Accounting.
Year 3: Security Analysis, Portfolio Management, Derivatives, Risk Management and electives.
Some programmes include a research project.

phases.title: Internships and certifications
phases.summary: Gain markets exposure with practical programmes.
points: Take internships in brokerages, banks, asset managers or fintech companies.
Complete NISM certifications and learn Excel and financial modelling.
Consider CFA Level I while in the final year.
Participate in stock market competitions.

phases.title: After BFM
points: Jobs: equity research associate, relationship manager, investment analyst, banking associate.
Higher study: MBA Finance, MFM, M.Com or financial engineering master’s degrees.
Professional: CFA, FRM, CA or CMA.
Government jobs: banking and insurance exams.
